name: microsoft-powerpoint
description: Agent skill (SKILL.md) for Microsoft PowerPoint: inspect, edit, render and safely share .pptx/.pptm/.ppsx/.potx decks. Covers slide masters, layouts and placeholders, python-pptx limits, charts with embedded workbooks, notes, sections, hidden slides, media, LibreOffice rendering in a sandbox, VBA, Office.js and Microsoft Graph. Includes hardened inspect, split-run replace, sanitize/share-check and sandboxed render scripts (Python, lxml).
author: Ali Tanveer
